fields.headline: Preliminary Report Filed — HUOG-ERP-1101
fields.narration: The Incident Commander has directed the Aviation Safety Officer to file a preliminary event report under HUOG-ERP Section 11.3 using the standard form (ERP-1101). The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has been instructed to confirm that no telemetry, Remote ID data, or vendor logs have been altered. All system logs are to be preserved in the incident folder on HUOG-NAS01. The report must include the narrative, timeline, and evidence collected to date.
keyFacts: ERP-1101 form has been initiated in the incident folder on HUOG-NAS01.
All logs from GCS-01, HWP-DETECT-01, and DAA-1 are preserved and unaltered.
The drone remains unidentified and is not registered in the FAA UAS Facility Map.
The serial 'RID-BM-12-004' is not in the Group’s fleet register (FOM-101).
The drone continues to broadcast in a circular pattern over the west grandstand.
fields.expectedAction: ASO must complete and submit the standard incident report (ERP-1101) to the hazard log and the ASO's in-box. SCL must verify that all GCS and vendor logs are unaltered and confirm data integrity in the incident folder. The ASO must not assume the drone is Group-owned or hostile without verified evidence.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the formal reporting chain has been activated. Watch for the ASO to begin drafting the report and the SCL to verify log integrity.
